title: Hoshino Ichika — A Direct Compliment〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Saki, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line:
Let's eat!
Let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, yes...!
I've got fried shrimp for lunch today!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Those look very good.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Your lunch also looks really yummy, Hona!
You've got Salisbury steaks today♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
Actually, would you like one?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow, thanks!
Then, you can have one of my shrimp♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're having two yakisoba buns again, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, the school store was really crowded, so I thought they'd run out. But I managed to get two.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm still amazed by how much you like them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That reminds me of the bread you see in stores with special stickers.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, the ones that allow you to win plates and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Imagine if they had those at the school store. You'd probably win a ton of stuff, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, based on how much bread you buy from there, you'd probably get truckloads of goodies...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm not sure what I'd do with all those things...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? Alright, what if it was all Miku merch?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, I'd want them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. I knew you'd say that!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of stickers...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What about them?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I found something I hadn't seen in forever while cleaning my room last night.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, like the first Miku merch you ever bought?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. Nope.
Honami's stickers. And they were still unused.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Remember how she used to put stickers on all her favorite things when we were little?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I remember!
She had all kinds of cute stickers, like flowers and animals and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, those...? I also remember them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wait, really...?
But that was so long ago. You all have very good memories.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, you stuck them on all your things.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Your pencil case, desk pad and basically all your other school supplies.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I did, didn't I...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait a second...
Why do you have her stickers, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I mean, they're her stickers, right?
And they're unused. Kinda strange, right...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, good point...
Why were they in my room?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Any idea why, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hmm... I can't recall. We are talking about when we were really little...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Do you remember now?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think she gave them to me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah. I don't remember why...
But I do think she gave them to me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Actually, I also kinda remember being given stickers at some point...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I also remember getting a few sheets now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. That means we were all given some.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But now I'm wondering why you gave them to us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Did you hand them out to us because you had a bunch of extras?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I think I remember now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, you do?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I have a feeling that I wanted to share my favorite stickers with all of you...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, back then, I did like to put stickers on basically everything...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think my hope was for my closest friends to use my favorite stickers in the same way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Now I see.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I was also sad because you didn't really use them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I think we wanted to save them for something special.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's totally true for me!
I remember thinking how cute those stickers were!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, then... You should've used them...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it's so hard to take them off once you've stuck them onto something! I didn't wanna waste them!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We would've used them if we knew that you wanted us to...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I... I was too embarrassed to actually say that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho, Ichika & Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.
